prompt.alinti: I built a 24/7 AI trader with ChatGPT. Instead of sitting in front of charts all day, the system helps me monitor markets, scan for setups, analyze what’s happening, and organize everything into a clear trading plan. Here’s the workflow: MARKETS — watches crypto, stocks, forex, and indexes SCAN - looks for trend, momentum, volume, breakouts, and volatility ALERTS — notifies me when something important changes ANALYZE - breaks down the setup and explains what’s happening TRADE PLAN — organizes entry, stop, targets, and invalidation before the trade RISK — checks position size, exposure, and risk/reward JOURNAL - logs the result so I can review what worked and what didn’t The full system: MARKETS → SCAN → ALERTS → ANALYZE → TRADE PLAN → RISK → JOURNAL The point isn’t to let AI blindly trade
FIRST, I WATCH THE MARKETS 24/7. Stocks, crypto, forex - one monitoring system.
THEN IT SCANS FOR SETUPS. It filters alerts and finds the charts worth checking.
THEN IT BUILDS THE TRADE PLAN. Entry. Exit. Invalidation. Before the trade.
THEN CHATGPT ANALYZES THE SETUP. Not just ‘buy’ or ‘sell’ — it explains why.
THEN IT CHECKS THE RISK FIRST. The trade doesn’t happen just because the setup looks good.
EVERY TRADE TEACHES THE SYSTEM. The more it trades, the smarter it gets.
